title: षोडशाधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 216 · Indra and Bali after the fall

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks how a king who has lost his fortune should live, and Bhishma tells of Indra finding the fallen asura Bali in an empty place. Bali answers Indra's taunts calmly, saying that time rules all and that Indra too will fall.
summary.kn: ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡ ರಾಜ ಹೇಗೆ ಬದುಕಬೇಕೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಇಂದ್ರ ಬಿದ್ದ ಅಸುರ ಬಲಿಯನ್ನು ಖಾಲಿ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡ ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬಲಿ ಇಂದ್ರನ ಹಂಗಿಸುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಶಾಂತವಾಗಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಕಾಲ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಆಳುತ್ತದೆ, ಇಂದ್ರನೂ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಾನೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि वैभव खो चुका राजा कैसे रहे, और भीष्म बताते हैं कि इन्द्र ने पतित असुर बलि को सूने स्थान में पाया। बलि इन्द्र के तानों का शान्त उत्तर देता है कि काल सब पर शासन करता है और इन्द्र भी गिरेगा।
summary.te: సంపద కోల్పోయిన రాజు ఎలా జీవించాలని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు; ఇంద్రుడు పతనమైన అసురుడు బలిని నిర్జన ప్రదేశంలో కనుగొన్న కథను భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. ఇంద్రుని ఎగతాళికి బలి ప్రశాంతంగా బదులిస్తూ కాలం అన్నిటినీ పాలిస్తుందని, ఇంద్రుడూ పడతాడని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: செல்வம் இழந்த மன்னன் எவ்வாறு வாழ வேண்டும் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, வீழ்ந்த அசுரன் பலியை இந்திரன் வெறுமையான இடத்தில் கண்டதைப் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். இந்திரனின் ஏளனத்துக்குப் பலி அமைதியாகப் பதிலளித்துக் காலம் எல்லாவற்றையும் ஆள்கிறது, இந்திரனும் வீழ்வான் என்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ഐശ്വര്യം നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട രാജാവ് എങ്ങനെ ജീവിക്കണമെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; ശൂന്യമായ സ്ഥലത്ത് വീണുപോയ അസുരനായ ബലിയെ ഇന്ദ്രൻ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. ഇന്ദ്രന്റെ പരിഹാസത്തിന് ബലി ശാന്തമായി മറുപടി നൽകുന്നു; എല്ലാറ്റിനെയും കാലം ഭരിക്കുന്നുവെന്നും ഇന്ദ്രനും വീഴുമെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.216; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
यया बुद्ध्या महीपालो भ्रष्टश्रीर्विचरेन्महीम् ।
कालदण्डविनिष्पिष्टस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, tell me by what understanding a king who has lost his fortune, crushed by the rod of time, may live on in the world.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
वासवस्य च संवादं बलेर्वैरोचनस्य च ॥

meaning.en: On this they tell this ancient account, the conversation of Indra and Bali, son of Virochana.

verses.text:
पितामहमुपागत्य प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः ।
सर्वानेवासुराञ्जित्वा बलिं पप्रच्छ वासवः ॥

meaning.en: After conquering all the asuras, Indra approached his grandfather Brahma, bowed with joined palms, and asked about Bali.

verses.text:
यस्य स्म ददतो वित्तं न कदाचन हीयते ।
तं बलिं नाधिगच्छामि ब्रह्मन्नाचक्ष्व मे बलिम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Brahma, I cannot find that Bali whose wealth never failed him as he gave it away. Tell me where Bali is.'

verses.text:
स एव ह्यस्तमयते स स्म विद्योतते दिशः ।
स वर्षति स्म वर्षाणि यथाकालमतन्द्रितः ।
तं बलिं नाधिगच्छामि ब्रह्मन्नाचक्ष्व मे बलिम् ॥

meaning.en: 'He alone set, he lit up the quarters, and he rained down rains in season, untiring. I cannot find that Bali; tell me where he is.'

verses.text:
स वायुर्वरुणश्चैव स रविः स च चन्द्रमाः ।
सोऽग्निस्तपति भूतानि पृथिवी च भवत्युत ।
तं बलिं नाधिगच्छामि ब्रह्मन्नाचक्ष्व मे बलिम् ॥

meaning.en: 'He was wind and Varuna, the sun and the moon; as fire he warmed beings, and he was the earth. I cannot find that Bali; tell me where he is.'

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
नैतत्ते साधु मघवन्यदेतदनुपृच्छसि ।
पृष्टस्तु नानृतं ब्रूयात्तस्माद्वक्ष्यामि ते बलिम् ॥

meaning.en: Maghavan, it is not good that you ask this. Yet one who is asked should not speak untruth, so I will tell you of Bali.

verses.text:
उष्ट्रेषु यदि वा गोषु खरेष्वश्वेषु वा पुनः ।
वरिष्ठो भविता जन्तुः शून्यागारे शचीपते ॥

meaning.en: Among camels, or cows, or donkeys or horses, lord of Shachi, that being will be in an empty house, the best of them.

verses.text: शक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Indra said:

verses.text:
यदि स्म बलिना ब्रह्मञ्शून्यागारे समेयिवान् ।
हन्यामेनं न वा हन्यां तद्ब्रह्मन्ननुशाधि माम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahma, if I meet Bali in an empty house, instruct me whether I should strike him or not.

verses.text: ब्रह्मोवाच

meaning.en: Brahma said:

verses.text:
मा स्म शक्र बलिं हिंसीर्न बलिर्वधमर्हति ।
न्यायांस्तु शक्र प्रष्टव्यस्त्वया वासव काम्यया ॥

meaning.en: Indra, do not harm Bali; Bali does not deserve to be killed. You should, Indra, question him as you wish, on matters of right.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तो भगवता महेन्द्रः पृथिवीं तदा ।
चचारैरावतस्कन्धमधिरुह्य श्रिया वृतः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by the lord, Mahendra then roamed the earth, mounted on the shoulders of Airavata and surrounded by splendour.

verses.text:
ततो ददर्श स बलिं खरवेषेण संवृतम् ।
यथाख्यातं भगवता शून्यागारकृतालयम् ॥

meaning.en: Then he saw Bali, covered in the form of a donkey, dwelling in an empty house as the lord had said.

verses.text: शक्र उवाच

meaning.en: Indra said:

verses.text:
खरयोनिमनुप्राप्तस्तुषभक्षोऽसि दानव ।
इयं ते योनिरधमा शोचस्याहो न शोचसि ॥

meaning.en: You have come to a donkey's birth, Danava, eating husks. This is your lowly state; do you grieve, or not?

verses.text:
अदृष्टं बत पश्यामि द्विषतां वशमागतम् ।
श्रिया विहीनं मित्रैश्च भ्रष्टवीर्यपराक्रमम् ॥

meaning.en: Alas, I see what I never saw: you in the power of your foes, stripped of fortune and friends, your might and valour gone.

verses.text:
यत्तद्यानसहस्रेण ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः ।
लोकान्प्रतापयन्सर्वान्यास्यस्मानवितर्कयन् ॥

meaning.en: You who once went in a thousand chariots, surrounded by kin, scorching all the worlds and heeding us not,

verses.text:
त्वन्मुखाश्चैव दैतेया व्यतिष्ठंस्तव शासने ।
अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी तवैश्वर्ये बभूव ह ।
इदं च तेऽद्य व्यसनं शोचस्याहो न शोचसि ॥

meaning.en: with the Daityas at your head standing at your command, and the earth bearing crops unploughed in your rule: and this is your calamity today. Do you grieve, or not?

verses.text:
यदातिष्ठः समुद्रस्य पूर्वकूले विलेलिहन् ।
ज्ञातिभ्यो विभजन्वित्तं तदासीत्ते मनः कथम् ॥

meaning.en: When you stayed on the eastern shore of the sea, tasting wealth as you shared it among your kin, what was in your mind then?

verses.text:
यत्ते सहस्रसमिता ननृतुर्देवयोषितः ।
बहूनि वर्षपूगानि विहारे दीप्यतः श्रिया ॥

meaning.en: When thousands of heavenly women danced for you, shining with splendour at your pleasure-garden, for many years,

verses.text:
सर्वाः पुष्करमालिन्यः सर्वाः काञ्चनसप्रभाः ।
कथमद्य तदा चैव मनस्ते दानवेश्वर ॥

meaning.en: all garlanded with lotuses, all gleaming like gold: how is your mind now, lord of the Danavas, compared with then?

verses.text:
छत्रं तवासीत्सुमहत्सौवर्णं मणिभूषितम् ।
ननृतुर्यत्र गन्धर्वाः षट्सहस्राणि सप्तधा ॥

meaning.en: You had a great golden parasol adorned with jewels, where six thousand Gandharvas danced in seven groups.

verses.text:
यूपस्तवासीत्सुमहान्यजतः सर्वकाञ्चनः ।
यत्राददः सहस्राणामयुतानि गवां दश ॥

meaning.en: You had a very great sacrificial post of solid gold when you sacrificed, at which you gave ten times ten thousands of thousands of cows.

verses.text:
यदा तु पृथिवीं सर्वां यजमानोऽनुपर्ययाः ।
शम्याक्षेपेण विधिना तदासीत्किं नु ते हृदि ॥

meaning.en: And when, as sacrificer, you went around the whole earth with the rite of the throwing of the peg, what was in your heart then?

verses.text:
न ते पश्यामि भृङ्गारं न छत्रं व्यजनं न च ।
ब्रह्मदत्तां च ते मालां न पश्याम्यसुराधिप ॥

meaning.en: I do not see your water-jar, your parasol, your fan, nor the garland Brahma gave you, lord of the asuras.

verses.text: बलिरुवाच

meaning.en: Bali said:

verses.text:
न त्वं पश्यसि भृङ्गारं न छत्रं व्यजनं न च ।
ब्रह्मदत्तां च मे मालां न त्वं द्रक्ष्यसि वासव ॥

meaning.en: You do not see my water-jar, parasol or fan, nor the garland Brahma gave me, Indra; and you will not see them.

verses.text:
गुहायां निहितानि त्वं मम रत्नानि पृच्छसि ।
यदा मे भविता कालस्तदा त्वं तानि द्रक्ष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: You ask after my jewels, laid away in a cave; when my time comes, you will see them.

verses.text:
न त्वेतदनुरूपं ते यशसो वा कुलस्य वा ।
समृद्धार्थोऽसमृद्धार्थं यन्मां कत्थितुमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: This is not worthy of your fame or your family, that you, prosperous, wish to boast to me, who am not.

verses.text:
न हि दुःखेषु शोचन्ति न प्रहृष्यन्ति चर्द्धिषु ।
कृतप्रज्ञा ज्ञानतृप्ताः क्षान्ताः सन्तो मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: The wise, of settled understanding, content with knowledge and patient, do not grieve in sorrows nor exult in prosperity.

verses.text:
त्वं तु प्राकृतया बुद्ध्या पुरंदर विकत्थसे ।
यदाहमिव भावी त्वं तदा नैवं वदिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: But you, Purandara, brag with a common mind; when you come to be as I am, you will not speak this way.
